messages:
maria: Quick report: reproducible hang when streaming via python SDK sample after a 401 refresh. Async generator stops yielding final chunks and caller cancel blocks.

maria: Minimal repro uses httpx async client + FastAPI SSE endpoint. Works until token refresh mid-stream, then reads stall, no exception.

alex: which httpx/python/uvloop? sounds like aclose ordering race.

maria: httpx 0.24.0, py3.11, uvloop in test harness.

devon: are you relying on generator finalizers to close the response? that can race with cancellation.

maria: yes. adding explicit try/finally and awaiting r.aclose() fixes it locally.

sam: we should expose an explicit abort() on the stream iterator and document async-with usage. abort should be idempotent and force-close the transport.

alex: short-term: docs + example recommending async with and explicit aclose/abort. mid-term: surface StreamAuthError when 401 occurs mid-stream instead of silent hang.

jiao: also add a typed AsyncStream wrapper so mypy users can annotate `AsyncIterator[str]` without noise. I'll open a docs + typing PR.

sam: i'll draft the error type and abort API. test should simulate 401 mid-stream and assert StreamAuthError and closed socket.

devon: option to transparently resume by replaying a prefix cache is interesting but requires server support; file as long-term idea.

ci-bot: auto-note: issue created devex#4582 stream-auth-hang by jiao.

alex: assign to py-sdk 0.25 milestone, add quickstart snippet and one-liner about cancel semantics.

maria: thanks — docs workaround unblocks my demo tomorrow. :relieved:
